title: NCAA lays out its case for Brendan Sorsby's banishment

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NCAA lays out its case for Brendan Sorsby's banishment
sources.description: On Monday, lawyers representing the NCAA and Texas Tech quarterback Brendan Sorsby will convene in a Texas courtroom to argue the question of whether Sorsby's eligibility to play college football should be temporarily reinstated.
